message.reasoning_content: I have no goods; buy 1 unit at 7 alashi? Sold counter=4, buy moves back... buying 1 unit costs ~7. But I have little cash; later I could sell at maybe 8. Marginal. Better keep cash? Bank is 30, cash pays rank. Buying 1 for 7 to sell later at higher price later maybe 8 — barely profit, but cash is devalued each round (62%). Actually cash floor/100*62 — 7 alashi becomes 4.34, so spending on goods preserves value if sell later at ~8 with credit*1.25. Buy.
